scope.pageState: Initial render of the submitted markup with page scripts blocked; no interaction beyond a Tab walk.
notes: Demo data: recorded from a real scan of a bundled sample page for a fictional clinic. It is not a scan of any live site.
The Tab walk reached 12 focusable elements.

findings.title: ARIA attribute name is not valid
findings.description: Browsers ignore misspelled ARIA attributes, so the intended state or property never reaches assistive technology.

node.html: Drag to reorder the clinicians you prefer to see.
node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Invalid ARIA attribute name: aria-labeledby
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Invalid ARIA attribute name: aria-labeledby

findings.recommendation: Correct the attribute name, or remove it if a native HTML attribute already covers it.

findings.title: Button has no accessible name
findings.description: Screen reader users hear only "button" and cannot tell what it does. Voice control users cannot say its name to press it.

node.html: <button type="button" class="icon-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5" stroke="#1f2933" fill="none"></circle></svg></button>
node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have inner text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
  Element does not have an explicit <label>
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Element does not have inner text that is visible to screen readers
aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
Element has no title attribute
Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
Element does not have an explicit <label>
Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

findings.recommendation: Give the button visible text. For an icon-only button, add an accessible name that describes the action.
manualReview: The name must describe the action, which only the author knows.

findings.title: Image has no text alternative
findings.description: Screen readers announce an image without alt text by its file name, or skip it, so anyone who cannot see it loses the information it carries.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Element does not have an alt attribute
aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
Element has no title attribute
Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

findings.recommendation: Add alt text that says what the image communicates in this context. If the image is purely decorative, use an empty alt attribute so it is skipped.
manualReview: Only a person who knows why the image is there can write its alt text.

findings.title: Form field has no label
findings.description: Without a programmatic label, screen readers cannot say what to enter, and clicking the label text does not focus the field.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
  Element does not have an explicit <label>
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element has no placeholder attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Element does not have an implicit (wrapped) <label>
Element does not have an explicit <label>
aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
Element has no title attribute
Element has no placeholder attribute
Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

findings.recommendation: Add a visible <label> associated with the field through for and id. Placeholder text is not a label.

findings.title: Autocomplete value is not valid
findings.description: Browsers and assistive tools cannot fill in or identify a field with an unrecognised autocomplete token.

node.failureSummary:
Fix all of the following:
  the autocomplete attribute is incorrectly formatted
evidence: Fix all of the following:
the autocomplete attribute is incorrectly formatted

findings.recommendation: Use a token from the HTML autofill list, such as email, given-name or street-address.

findings.title: Text contrast is below the minimum
findings.description: People with low vision or colour deficiencies, and anyone reading in bright light, may not be able to read this text against its background.

node.html: Walk-in hours are limited this week. Book online to reserve a time.
node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.81 (foreground color: #9a9a9a, background color: #ffffff, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.81 (foreground color: #9a9a9a, background color: #ffffff, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

findings.recommendation: Darken or lighten the text colour (or the background) until the ratio meets the threshold. The workspace proposes the nearest colour that keeps the hue.
manualReview: Check the new colour in hover, focus, visited and disabled states.
Confirm the change fits the brand palette before shipping.

findings.title: Page has no title
findings.description: The title is the first thing a screen reader announces and the label on the browser tab. Without it, people cannot tell pages apart.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Document does not have a non-empty <title> element
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Document does not have a non-empty <title> element

findings.recommendation: Add a <title> that names the page's topic or purpose.

findings.title: Page language is not declared
findings.description: Screen readers use the page language to choose pronunciation rules. Without it, content may be read with the wrong voice and accent.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  The <html> element does not have a lang attribute
evidence: Fix any of the following:
The <html> element does not have a lang attribute

findings.recommendation: Add a lang attribute to the html element with the content's primary language.
manualReview: Confirm the language code matches the content.

findings.title: Positive tabindex changes the focus order
findings.description: Positive tabindex values pull elements ahead of the natural order, which usually confuses keyboard users.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has a tabindex greater than 0
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Element has a tabindex greater than 0

findings.recommendation: Use tabindex="0" and arrange the DOM order to match the visual order.

findings.title: Touch target is too small
findings.description: Small targets with little spacing are hard to hit for people with tremors, limited dexterity or large fingers.

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size (18px by 18px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 12px instead of at least 24px.
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Target has insufficient size (18px by 18px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 12px instead of at least 24px.

findings.recommendation: Make the target at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or keep a 24 pixel circle around it free of other targets.

findings.title: Zooming is disabled
findings.description: The viewport meta tag blocks pinch zoom, which people with low vision rely on.

node.failureSummary:

findings.recommendation: Remove user-scalable=no and any maximum-scale below 2 from the viewport meta tag.

findings.title: No visible focus indicator
findings.description: Keyboard users cannot see which control is focused, so they cannot tell where they are on the page.

evidence: Reached by Tab press 2.
When focused, it shows no outline and none of its border, shadow, background, colour or underline styles change.

findings.recommendation: Add a :focus-visible style with an outline or ring at 3:1 contrast against the surrounding background.
manualReview: Tab through the page and confirm the indicator is visible on every control.

findings.title: Focus outline removed without a replacement
findings.description: A stylesheet removes the browser's focus outline and adds no other focus style.

evidence: The rule removes the outline for "a:focus, button:focus" and adds no replacement indicator.
No focus or focus-visible rule on the page restores one.

findings.recommendation: Remove the outline reset, or add a visible :focus-visible style alongside it.

findings.title: Pasting into a credential field is blocked
findings.description: Blocking paste stops password managers and forces people to transcribe or remember credentials.

evidence: The onpaste handler cancels paste on a password field.

findings.recommendation: Remove the paste handler so people can paste and use password managers.

findings.title: Custom button instead of a native button
findings.description: An element with role="button" needs scripted keyboard handling that is often missing. A native button provides it for free.

evidence: A div with role="button" re-creates a native button by hand.
It has no tabindex, so keyboard users cannot reach it at all.

findings.recommendation: Replace the element with <button type="button">.

findings.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
findings.description: Ensure that elements labelled through their content must have their visible text as part of their accessible name

node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Unable to determine if the visible text is part of the accessible name
evidence: Fix any of the following:
Unable to determine if the visible text is part of the accessible name

findings.recommendation: Follow the rule guidance: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name.

findings.title: Drag interaction needs a single-pointer alternative
findings.description: People who cannot hold and drag need another way to do the same thing.

evidence: This element can be dragged. WCAG 2.2 requires a single-pointer alternative unless dragging is essential.

findings.recommendation: Provide buttons, a menu or click-to-place as an alternative to dragging.

limitations: Automated rules detect a subset of WCAG failures. A clean result does not mean the page conforms.
Only the tested page state was inspected: no menus were opened, forms submitted or content expanded.
Keyboard checks are heuristics from a scripted Tab walk; they cannot confirm that every task is operable.
Screen reader output, cognitive load and the meaning of text alternatives require a person.
Submitted source was rendered with page scripts and all network requests blocked.
